resources.name: If you are in danger right now
resources.description: Call 911. If it is not safe to talk, you can stay on the line, or text 911 where your area allows it.

resources.name: Indiana Coalition Against Domestic Violence hotline
resources.description: A free, private hotline for people in Indiana, open 24 hours. An advocate can talk with you about safety and protection orders.

resources.name: National Domestic Violence Hotline
resources.description: Free and private, open 24 hours. You can call, or text START to 88788. Help is also available by chat at thehotline.org.

resources.name: Local advocate programs in Indiana
resources.description: The Indiana Coalition Against Domestic Violence lists advocate programs in each county.
